description: Demo remediation set. Each patch repairs one finding and is applied on top of the reviewed build by `npm run demo:remediate`. Patches are keyed by the harness's finding key, not by a FIND number, so they still match if finding numbering changes.

patches.summary: Scope the referral source detail lookup to the caller's tenant
Enforce the rep activity filter restriction on the server
Revoke API tokens together with browser sessions
Re-check the patient module flag when queued work executes
Bucket monthly activity counts by activity_date
